description.en: Console mode, BIOS, SD card and battery settings.
description.zh-Hans: 主机模式、BIOS、SD 卡与电量设置。

description.en:
Whether melonDS should emulate a Nintendo DS or a Nintendo DSi. DSi mode has some limits:

- Native BIOS/firmware/NAND files must be provided, including for the regular DS.
- Some features (such as savestates) are not available in DSi mode.
- Direct boot mode cannot be used for DSiWare.

See the DSi-specific options in this category for more information. If unsure, set to DS mode unless playing a DSi game. Changes take effect at the next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 模拟 DS 还是 DSi。DSi 模式限制较多：必须提供真机的 BIOS、固件和 NAND 文件，不支持即时存档，DSiWare 也不能用直接启动。不确定时保持 DS 模式。

description.en:
The peripheral that will be inserted into the emulated console's Slot-2. Ignored in DSi mode, or if a GBA ROM is explicitly loaded. If a GBA ROM for any game in the Boktai trilogy is inserted, the corresponding Solar Sensor setting will be forced. In supported NDS games, each Boktai cart will have different effects. 
Changes take effect at next core start.
description.zh-Hans: 模拟插在 GBA 卡槽中的扩展设备。「自动」会根据游戏自动选择。

description.en:
Determines whether melonDS uses native BIOS/firmware dumps or its own built-in replacements. Only applies to DS mode, as DSi mode always requires native BIOS and firmware dumps.

Native mode uses BIOS and firmware files from a real DS. Place your dumps of these in the system directory or its "melonDS DS" subdirectory and name them as follows:

- DS BIOS: bios7.bin, bios9.bin
- DSi BIOS: dsi_bios7.bin, dsi_bios9.bin
- Firmware: See the "DS Firmware" and "DSi Firmware" options.
- DSi NAND: See the "DSi NAND " option.

Falls back to Built-In if any BIOS/firmware file isn't found.

Built-In mode uses melonDS's built-in BIOS and firmware, and is suitable for most games.

Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 使用真机的 BIOS 和固件文件，还是使用内置的开源替代实现。真机固件兼容性更好，需要先在核心 BIOS 中添加对应文件。

description.en:
Determines how melonDS boots games.

Native: Load games through the system menu, similar to the real DS/DSi boot process. Requires native BIOS and firmware files in the system directory.
Direct: Skip the system menu and go straight to the game. Supported for DSiWare if native DSi system files are available.

Ignored if loaded without a game (Native is forced) or if using Built-In BIOS/Firmware (Direct is forced). Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 「直接」跳过开机动画直接进入游戏；「真机」会先显示 DS 的开机画面和菜单，需要真机固件。

description.en: If enabled, a virtual SD card will be made available to the emulated DSi. The card image must be within the frontend's system directory and be named dsi_sd_card.bin. If no image exists, a 4GB virtual SD card will be created. Ignored in DS mode. Changes take effect at next boot.
description.zh-Hans: 为 DSi 模式模拟一张 SD 卡。

description.en: If enabled, the emulated DSi sees the virtual SD card as read-only. Changes take effect with next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 开启后游戏对 DSi 虚拟 SD 卡的写入不会保存。

description.en: If enabled, the virtual SD card's files will be synced to this core's save directory. Enable this if you want to add files to the virtual SD card from outside the core. Syncing happens when loading and unloading a game, so external changes won't have any effect while the core is running. Takes effect at the next boot. Adjusting this setting may overwrite existing save data.
description.zh-Hans: 关闭游戏时，把虚拟 SD 卡中的改动同步回设备上的文件夹。

title.zh-Hans: 同步 SD 卡到设备（DSi）

description.en: If enabled, a virtual SD card will be made available to homebrew DS games. The card image must be within the frontend's system directory and be named dldi_sd_card.bin. If no image exists, a 4GB virtual SD card will be created. Ignored for retail games. Changes take effect at next boot.
description.zh-Hans: 为自制游戏模拟一张 SD 卡。

description.en: If enabled, homebrew applications will see the virtual SD card as read-only. Changes take effect with next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 开启后自制游戏对虚拟 SD 卡的写入不会保存。

description.en: If enabled, the virtual SD card's files will be synced to this core's save directory. Enable this if you want to add files to the virtual SD card from outside the core. Syncing happens when loading and unloading a game, so external changes won't have any effect while the core is running. Takes effect at the next boot. Adjusting this setting may overwrite existing save data.
description.zh-Hans: 关闭游戏时，把虚拟 SD 卡中的改动同步回设备上的文件夹。

title.zh-Hans: 同步 SD 卡到设备

description.en: How often the emulated console's battery should be updated. Ignored if the frontend can't get the device's battery level.
description.zh-Hans: 每隔多久把设备的电量同步给模拟的主机。

description.en: If the host's battery level falls below this percentage, the emulated DS will report that its battery level is low. Ignored if running in DSi mode, no battery is available, or the frontend can't query the power status.
description.zh-Hans: 设备电量低于该值时，模拟的 DS 会认为电量不足并亮起低电量指示灯。

description.en: Date and time settings for the emulated console.
description.zh-Hans: 模拟主机的日期和时间设置。

description.en:
The initial time of the emulated console's internal clock.

- Real: Start in sync with your device's clock.
- Synchronized: Synchronize the emulated clock to your device's clock. May cause unexpected behavior in some games when rewinding or fast-forwarding.
- Relative: Start in sync with your device's clock, plus or minus a specified offset. Will be constrained to dates that the DS can represent.
- Absolute: Start at a specific date and time, regardless of your device's clock.

All dates and times are in your local timezone. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 设置模拟主机的时钟。「真实」使用设备当前时间；「同步」在此基础上持续同步；「相对」按设定的偏移量调整；「绝对」使用指定的固定时间。

description.en: The number of years to offset the starting time by. Only used when Starting Time Mode is Relative. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 相对模式下，模拟主机的时间相对设备时间偏移多少年。

description.en: The number of days to offset the starting time by. Only used when Starting Time Mode is Relative. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 相对模式下，模拟主机的时间相对设备时间偏移多少天。

description.en: The number of hours to offset the starting time by. Only used when Starting Time Mode is Relative. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 相对模式下，模拟主机的时间相对设备时间偏移多少小时。

description.en: The number of minutes to offset the starting time by. Only used when Starting Time Mode is Relative. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 相对模式下，模拟主机的时间相对设备时间偏移多少分钟。

description.en: The initial year to use when Starting Time Mode is Absolute. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 绝对模式下，模拟主机启动时的年份。

description.en: The initial month to use when Starting Time Mode is Absolute. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 绝对模式下，模拟主机启动时的月份。

description.en: The initial day of the month to use when Starting Time Mode is Absolute. Days that extend past the end of a month will roll over to the next (e.g. April 31st will become May 1st). Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 绝对模式下，模拟主机启动时的日期。

description.en: The initial hour to use when Starting Time Mode is Absolute. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 绝对模式下，模拟主机启动时的小时。

description.en: The initial minute to use when Starting Time Mode is Absolute. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 绝对模式下，模拟主机启动时的分钟。

description.en: Rendering settings.
description.zh-Hans: 渲染相关设置。

description.en: If enabled, the software renderer will run on a separate thread. Changes take effect immediately. If unsure, leave this enabled.
description.zh-Hans: 在单独的线程上进行软件渲染，通常能提升性能，但可能增加一点延迟。

description.en: Audio output and microphone input settings.
description.zh-Hans: 音频输出与麦克风输入设置。

description.en: What to feed the emulated microphone while the mic button is held. 'Blow' simulates blowing into it, which is what most games expect.
description.zh-Hans: 按下麦克风键时，向模拟主机输入什么声音。「吹气」模拟对着麦克风吹气，适合需要吹气的游戏；「静音」输入无声；「噪声」输入白噪声。

description.en:
Set the behavior of the Microphone button, even if Microphone Input Mode is set to Blow or Noise. The emulated microphone receives silence when disabled by the button.

Hold: Button enables mic input while held.
Toggle: Button enables mic input when pressed, disables it when pressed again.
Always: Button is ignored, mic input is always enabled.

Ignored if Microphone Input Mode is set to Silence.
description.zh-Hans: 麦克风键的触发方式：按住生效、点按切换，或始终开启。

description.en: The number of bits used for each audio sample. Automatic matches the original hardware's behavior by using 10-bit audio for DS mode and 16-bit audio for DSi mode. If unsure, set to Automatic.
description.zh-Hans: 音频输出的位深。DS 为 10 位，DSi 为 16 位，「自动」按主机模式选择。

description.en: Interpolates audio output for improved quality. Disable this to match the behavior of the original DS hardware.
description.zh-Hans: 对音频重采样使用的插值算法，可以让声音更平滑。真机没有这一处理。

description.en: Screen layout, gap and touch settings.
description.zh-Hans: 双屏布局、间距与触摸设置。

description.en: Determines when a cursor should appear on the bottom screen. Never is recommended for touch screens; the other settings are best suited for mouse or joystick input.
description.zh-Hans: 何时在下屏显示触摸光标。

description.en: If Cursor Mode is set to "Until Timeout", then the cursor will be hidden if it hasn't been moved for a certain time.
description.zh-Hans: 最后一次触摸后，光标继续显示多久。

description.en:
Determines how the console's touch screen is emulated.

Joystick: Use a joystick to control the cursor. Recommended if you don't have a mouse or a real touch screen available.
Pointer: Use your mouse or touch screen to control the cursor.
Auto: Use either Joystick or Pointer, depending on which you last touched.

If unsure, set to Auto.
description.zh-Hans: 如何操作下屏：用摇杆移动光标，或直接触摸屏幕。「自动」会根据最近使用的输入方式切换。

description.en: The number of screen layouts to cycle through with the Next Layout button.
description.zh-Hans: 可以循环切换的布局数量。游戏中用「切换布局」按键在这些布局之间轮换。
第 1 个屏幕布局。
第 2 个屏幕布局。
第 3 个屏幕布局。
第 4 个屏幕布局。
第 5 个屏幕布局。
第 6 个屏幕布局。
第 7 个屏幕布局。
第 8 个屏幕布局。

description.en: The size of the larger screen relative to the smaller ones when using a hybrid layout.
description.zh-Hans: 混合布局中主屏幕相对小屏幕的放大倍数。

description.en: Choose which screens will be shown when using a hybrid layout.
description.zh-Hans: 混合布局中侧边显示哪块屏幕。

description.en: Choose how large the gap between the screens should be. Vertical layouts (including rotations) only. Dimensions exclude the effects of the frontend's scaling.
description.zh-Hans: 上下屏之间留出的间距，单位为像素。

description.en: Override the emulated firmware's settings.
description.zh-Hans: 覆盖模拟主机固件中的个人设置。

description.en: Override the language stored in the emulated firmware. Multi-language games follow this setting.
description.zh-Hans: 覆盖模拟主机固件中的语言设置。多语言游戏会跟随这个设置显示对应语言。

description.en:
Overrides the username given to the emulated console.

Don't Override: Uses whatever name is defined on the firmware.
Guess: Try to get your username from the frontend. If that fails, try the USER, USERNAME, and LOGNAME environment variables.
melonDS DS: Uses "melonDS DS". This is the default if nothing else works.

Names are truncated to 10 characters. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 覆盖模拟主机固件中的用户名。部分游戏会显示这个名字。

description.en: The theme ("favorite color") of the emulated console. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 覆盖模拟主机固件中的主题颜色，会影响 DS 系统菜单和部分游戏的配色。

description.en: The month of your birthday. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 覆盖模拟主机固件中的生日月份。部分游戏会在生日当天给出特别问候。

description.en: The day within the month of your birthday. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 覆盖模拟主机固件中的生日日期。

description.en: Whether the emulated console's alarm is enabled. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 覆盖模拟主机固件中的闹钟开关。

description.en: The hour of the configured alarm. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 覆盖模拟主机固件中的闹钟小时。

description.en: The minute of the configured alarm. Changes take effect at next restart.
description.zh-Hans: 覆盖模拟主机固件中的闹钟分钟。

description.en: Change what extra information is shown on-screen.
description.zh-Hans: 控制屏幕上额外显示哪些信息。

description.en: Enable to display an on-screen message if melonDS tries to use certain unsupported features. These warnings will be logged regardless of this setting.
description.zh-Hans: 游戏使用了当前不支持的功能时显示提示。

description.en: Enable to display warnings if your BIOS files have certain known problems. A warning will always be shown if your BIOS files are missing or invalid, regardless of this setting.
description.zh-Hans: BIOS 或固件文件存在问题时显示提示。

description.en: Enable to show which screen layout within the configured sequence is active.
description.zh-Hans: 切换屏幕布局时在屏幕上显示当前布局名称。

description.en: Enable to show whether your device's microphone is active.
description.zh-Hans: 麦克风开启或关闭时在屏幕上显示提示。

description.en: Enable to show whether your device's camera is active.
description.zh-Hans: 摄像头开启或关闭时在屏幕上显示提示。

description.en: Enable to show whether the emulated screens are closed.
description.zh-Hans: 模拟的机盖开合时在屏幕上显示提示。

description.en: Enable to show the emulated input of any peripheral sensors that aren't already managed by one of the other OSD options, e.g. the solar sensor embedded in the Boktai trilogy's carts. If no peripherals (including GBA carts) are available, this option will have no effect.
description.zh-Hans: 使用光感卡带等传感器设备时，在屏幕上显示当前读数。
